spells_alias.name: Banishment
spells_alias.effect_text: Place a unit or a token adjacent to you into a space in radius.

spells_alias.name: Sunburst
spells_alias.effect_text: Target a unit at maximum range. +1 :attack: Attack and +1 Range for each other spell card removed from the spellbook.

spells_alias.name: Energy Drain
spells_alias.effect_text: An enemy hero in range discards a non-basic card, if able. Your team regains 1 spent :life_counter: Life counter.

spells_alias.name: Cloud Kill
spells_alias.effect_text: An enemy hero in radius discards a basic card, if able.

spells_alias.name: Invulnerability
spells_alias.effect_text: This Round: You are immune to non-basic attacks.

spells_alias.name: Power Word Kill
spells_alias.effect_text: Defeat an enemy hero in radius with no cards in hand.

spells_alias.name: Polymorph
spells_alias.effect_text: Swap an enemy hero in radius with a token in radius or with an enemy minion in radius.

spells_alias.name: Wish
spells_alias.effect_text: Cast any spell in the Spellbook. After you cast the "Wish" spell three times your team wins the game.

spell_alias.name: Magic Missile
spell_alias.effect_text: Target a unit in range and not adjacent to you.
